verdict.rationale: Mercury documents AI bill reading that auto-populates bill details so you can 'approve and pay'. It also documents payment approval controls: send-money requests governed by organization approval policies, and gated disbursements that require sign-off in the dashboard before funds are released. However, the evidence never explicitly describes how bills are uploaded or ingested, or how a bill itself is routed through multi-step approvers, so the end-to-end bill-to-approval workflow is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit bill upload/ingestion documentation, documented bill-specific approval routing (approver chains, rules by amount or vendor), independent or hands-on corroboration of the bill-pay approval flow.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can upload bills and route them through an approval workflow before paying vendors

citations.quote: AI reads bills, populates details automatically, and remembers past recipients — so you can approve and pay in seconds.
Pay recipients from your Mercury accounts over ACH, check, domestic wire, and international wire, with optional approval controls.
Create a "request to send money" that will require approval based on your organization's approval policies.
Queue transactions via API for manual review and sign-off inside the Mercury dashboard prior to release of funds.
